title: Mixer visibility and components
contract: Mixer controls are available from Session and Arrangement; the bottom-right mixer control shows/hides the section, with its adjacent menu controlling component visibility. Arrangement also offers Track Controls. No geometry, accessibility order or persistence law is supplied.

title: Resizable meter presentation
contract: Increasing mixer height reveals tick marks, numeric volume and resettable peak-level indicators; increased track width adds a decibel scale. These are presentation roles, with no pixel thresholds, calibrated detector or reset duration.

title: Selected mixer controls move together
contract: With multiple tracks selected, editing one mixer control edits that control for the selected tracks. The source describes preserving existing knob/slider differences; coordinates/units, clamping, boundary interactions and exact transformations remain unknown. Existing mixer values own numeric laws.

title: Pan mode menu and reset gestures
contract: Pan context menu chooses Stereo versus Split Stereo presentation; Split offers independent left/right controls. Double-clicking Pan or clicking its triangle in the Session/Arrangement mixer resets to the described default. Numeric defaults, ramps and stereo processing remain with mixer values.

title: Exclusive and multiselected Solo controls
contract: Solo supports selected-track sets. Outside that multi-selection context, ordinary exclusivity is bypassed by Ctrl on Windows/Cmd on Mac or disabled Exclusive Solo preference. S invokes the solo shortcut in an eligible focus context owned by keyboard/remote control. Arbitrary routed graph muting remains separately owned.

title: Nonadjacent track move context
contract: Adjacent/nonadjacent selection is described with Shift/Ctrl-click. Dragging nonadjacent tracks collapses them together at drop; Ctrl+arrow moves without collapsing. This paragraph does not qualify Ctrl by platform, so no Cmd substitution or complete focus/ordering grammar is inferred.

title: Track numbering names
contract: A leading # produces an automatically updated track number when moved; extra # characters add leading zeros. Prefix parsing beyond this example, numbering basis, interaction with renaming/history and exact rendered text remain unknown.

title: Clip drag to a new track
contract: Dragging one or multiple existing clips into empty space right of Session tracks or below Arrangement tracks creates a new track carrying those clips and the original track devices. This does not establish device-copy state, mappings, media bytes, source ownership or processing equivalence.

title: Group creation and nesting
contract: Group Tracks combines selected audio/MIDI tracks, including existing groups nested in a new group. Groups have mixer controls and can host audio effects but cannot contain clips. Group routing is owned by routing-monitoring; Session group slots remain their own owner.

title: Group folding and Arrangement overview
contract: Unfold Group shows/hides contained tracks; Arrangement groups show an overview of contained clips. Hidden tracks are not inferred inactive, and overview graphics are not playable group clips or timing/audio proof.

title: Group movement, deletion and ungrouping
contract: Tracks may be dragged into/out of a group. Deleting a group deletes its contents; Ungroup Tracks restores individual tracks. Exact nested deletion/selection, Undo/media deletion and rerouting are not supplied.

title: Group color applies to active view clips
contract: Assign Track Color to Grouped Tracks and Clips applies group color to contained tracks and clips. In Session it affects Session clips; in Arrangement it affects Arrangement clips. Nested/selected subsets and palette equality remain unresolved.

title: Group descendant solo indicator
contract: A group Solo button appears half colored when a child track or nested group is soloed. The source supplies no exact RGB/pixel measure or complete status precedence.

title: Return Send enable entrypoints
contract: Return Send knobs are documented disabled by default, with Enable Send/Enable All Sends in their context menu. This is a control admission description; no identity with stored EnabledByUser or active-bit derivation, feedback stability or audible send is established.

title: Crossfader visibility and curve choice
contract: Crossfader visibility is offered via Mixer Controls or the mixer-control menu; its context menu offers seven curves. The uninspected chart is not a numerical curve source. Existing mixer values retain names/codes/curve functions and assignment laws.

title: Crossfader mapping gesture contexts
contract: The main slider and absolute left/right positions are separately assignable. The source describes a key assigned to any of left/center/right fields toggling absolute endpoints and two-field held-key press/release snap-back. Focus, repeat, overlapping input and restoration order remain unknown.

title: Crossfader automation entrypoints
contract: Crossfader gestures can be recorded into Arrangement; track assignment edits use Mixer then X-Fade Assign in envelope choosers. This adds the editing entrypoint, not automation timebase, override, persistence or audio coefficients.

title: Solo in Place and return-solo contexts
contract: Solo in Place is offered in Solo context menu and as an Options default. Soloed clip tracks can leave returns audible in that context; return solo mutes other main outputs while preserving arriving sends. Routing exceptions in the source and existing finite assumptions prevent an all-graph solo law.

title: Multi-control units, name/order and focus
contract: Relative multi-edit units/clamping, mixed pan modes, prefix numbering grammar, drag/device state and Ctrl/platform/focus histories remain unknown.

title: Group scope and source contexts
contract: Group slot launch/stop context in Mixing B043 versus existing Session group-slot owner, nesting/media/Undo/move/ungroup and color/solo precedence remain unknown.

title: Arm preference and implicit-arm context
contract: Mixing B014 documents Exclusive Arm and new/empty MIDI instrument implicit arm; recording REQ001 retains preference/implicit-arm U. Preserve this new source context without silently revising that sealed owner.

title: Curve and remote gesture context
contract: B066/067 describes unattenuated half ranges without naming a curve; existing finite seven-curve functions differ. Keep source/curve context U and do not replace numeric laws. Keyboard held-input and automation histories remain unknown.

title: Build, state and processing lifecycle
contract: Exact12.4.3 controls/defaults, malformed inputs, permissions/source loss, cancellation, undo/persistence, event ordering, active audio/MIDI/rate changes and teardown remain required unknowns.
